top_signals.title: Carry Trade Exodus Fuels Yen Surge Ahead of BOJ Rate Decision
top_signals.summary: A rush to unwind yen-funded carry trades helped send the currency to a one-month high against the dollar as traders ramped up bets on further Bank of Japan rate hikes.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Philippine Inflation Eases to 6.1% After Successive Rate Hikes
top_signals.summary: Philippine inflation eased for the fourth straight month in August while staying above the central bank’s target, on slower increases in utility rates and food prices.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Tokyo DisneySea continues to evolve after 25 years
top_signals.summary: The only ocean-themed Disney park in the world has continued to attract and excite visitors from both in and outside Japan since its opening on Sept. 4, 2001.
